organization: Coast is inside Ocean Mother; one workbench with Coast and preserved deep-ocean tabs

model.water: depth-averaged finite-volume shallow water with recorded boundary forcing
model.foam: uncalibrated advected surface coverage plus decay
model.wetSand: contact-driven wetness with delayed drying; same state drives color and gloss
model.spray: ballistic particles with gravity and wind
model.smoke: advected expanding appearance parcels; heat proxy; no gas pressure or chemistry solver
model.fire: procedural emissive volume and local light driven by heat proxy
model.wind: read-only frozen environment convention +X east, +Y up, -Z north
model.terrain: procedural experiment; no measured shoreline or bathymetry
model.deepOceanInboundCoupling: not implemented; this preview uses its own explicitly accounted numerical inlet source, not an imported deep-sea velocity field

policy.previewGuard: policy identity plus restricted domain parameters before generation, mutation and export; publication checks exact policy identity

numericalAndState.scope: Node tests mainly use 48x32 cells; actual 144x112 runtime additionally exercised in browser

publicBrowser.scope: real Chromium in GitHub Actions; emulated mobile viewport, not mobile hardware

evidence.internalVisualInspection: actual environment, shore and fire browser captures reviewed; this is not user approval

performance.scope: three warmed six-second paused-view windows per viewport on software renderer
performance.onBacklog: retain simulation debt and explicitly pause; no silent time loss

unresolved: True overhanging three-dimensional breakers are not represented.
No full three-dimensional liquid or multiphase foam solver.
No gas pressure/combustion chemistry or smoke-obstacle flow solution.
No water extinguishing fire, sediment, seepage, tides, rigid-body buoyancy or two-way solid coupling.
Foam whiteness and distribution, jagged rock-foot material/wet-dry transition, fire readability and smoke shading require further visual refinement.
Original strict shared Schema and validator are still missing; complete shared acceptance gate is not integrated.
Actual user GPU and physical phone performance remain unverified.
The existing deep viewer is unchanged; its full physics is not coupled to the new inlet.
